snippet.title: Here Comes The Swarm - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Here Comes the Swarm is a survival RTS with a pause button. Build and defend settlements, lead expeditions to eradicate fiends and deal a blow to the hivemind. Set in an infested world in ruin, will you reclaim Ulora from the relentless Swarm?

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3052730/Here_Comes_The_Swarm/
Discord Server: https://discord.gg/JbU2uHFPUv
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@herecomestheswarm
Website: http://cablehookgames.com/
